title: 1940s women school cadets
description: The female cadets of Hartland High School are shown in formation on the west side of the school. Although the specific occasion is unknown, students from surrounding communities often gathered for inter-platoon activities and competitions. The cadets learned discipline, engaged in physical training for strength, practiced presenting arms, saluting, and marching. This photograph was taken in the early 1940s.
